question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. Unanimous.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unanimous** means "fully in agreement or united in opinion".
 
• The word "unanimous" comes from the Latin word "unanimus," which translates to "one-minded."
 
• Correct spelling is essential for clear communication, and "Unanimous" is widely used in contexts of agreement, decision-making, or voting.

Example Sentence:

 
• The committee was unanimous in its decision to approve the new policy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incorrect options:**
 
 
• **Option 1 - Unlanimous:** Misspelled version of "Unanimous."
 
• **Option 3 - Uninamous:** Another misspelled version of "Unanimous."
 
• **Option 4 - Unanimus:** Incorrect spelling that drops the "o."
